ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, two parallel metal rails with a spacing of $L=0.1\mathrm{m}$ on a horizontal plane (the plane of the paper) are connected at the left end to a resistor with a resistance of $R=0.01\Omega$. A smooth metal rod with a mass of $m=0.1\mathrm{kg}$ is placed on the rails. The metal rod starts from rest under the action of a constant horizontal force $F=0.1\mathrm{N}$ directed to the right. After a time $t=2\mathrm{s}$, the metal rod enters a magnetic field with a velocity $v$. The magnetic field has a magnetic induction strength of $B=0.2\mathrm{T}$ and is directed perpendicularly into the plane of the paper (the magnetic field region is sufficiently large, and the rails are sufficiently long). The resistance of the rod and the rails is negligible, and they remain perpendicular and in good contact at all times. Find:

1. What is the magnitude of the velocity $v$ of the metal rod as it enters the magnetic field?
2. What is the magnitude of the acceleration $a$ of the metal rod as it just enters the magnetic field?
3. What is the maximum speed that a metal rod can reach?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two horizontal parallel metal rails, whose left end is connected into a circuit by a resistor labeled R; a vertical metal rod is connected across the two rails, and the rod is subjected to a constant force F to the right; on the right side there is a vertical dashed line, indicating the starting boundary of the magnetic-field region; to the right of the dashed line there are multiple crosses drawn, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface inward; the distance between the rails is labeled l on the right side, namely the L given in the problem. Reasoning calculation: The problem gives L=0.1 m, R=0.01 Ω, m=0.1 kg, F=0.1 N, t=2 s, B=0.2 T. Before the metal rod enters the magnetic field, it is not subjected to magnetic force, and only the constant force F acts, so the initial-stage acceleration is a0=F/m=0.1/0.1=1 m/s². The rod starts from rest and enters the magnetic field after moving for 2 s, therefore the velocity when entering the magnetic field is v=a0 t=1×2=2 m/s. Just when entering the magnetic field, the metal rod cuts magnetic induction lines and produces motional electromotive force ε=BLv=0.2×0.1×2=0.04 V. The circuit current is I=ε/R=0.04/0.01=4 A. By Lenz's law, the magnetic force hinders the rod from moving to the right, and its magnitude is FB=BIL=0.2×4×0.1=0.08 N. At this time the resultant force is F-FB=0.1-0.08=0.02 N, so the magnitude of acceleration is a=(F-FB)/m=0.02/0.1=0.2 m/s². When the metal rod reaches the maximum velocity, the acceleration is zero, and the magnetic resistance force balances the external force: F=B²L²vmax/R. Therefore vmax=FR/(B²L²)=0.1×0.01/(0.2²×0.1²)=0.001/0.0004=2.5 m/s.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: two horizontal rails are joined by a resistor on the left; a vertical conducting rod bridges the rails and is pulled to the right by force F; the dashed vertical line marks the start of the magnetic-field region; crosses on the right indicate B into the page; the rail separation is labeled L/l. From the text take L=0.1 m, R=0.01 ohm, m=0.1 kg, F=0.1 N, t=2 s, B=0.2 T, and negligible rail/rod resistance. Before the rod reaches the field, no magnetic force acts, so a0=F/m and v=(F/m)t. Just after entering, use motional emf epsilon=BLv, current I=epsilon/R, and magnetic drag force F_B=BIL=B^2L^2v/R opposite the motion by Lenz's law. Then a=(F-F_B)/m at v=2 m/s. The maximum speed occurs when the magnetic drag balances the applied force, F=B^2L^2v_max/R.

当金属杆达到最大速度时，加速度为零，磁阻力与外力平衡：F=B²L²vmax/R。因此 vmax=FR/(B²L²)=0.1×0.01/(0.2²×0.1²)=0.001/0.0004=2.5 m/s。

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the rod spans the two rails and moves right under the arrow F toward a dashed boundary; to the right of that boundary the crosses show a uniform magnetic field into the paper; the resistor on the left is the only resistance in the circuit; the vertical rail gap is L/l. From the text take all given constants. For the entry speed, use impulse or work before the field: since there is no magnetic region yet and the surface is smooth, the only horizontal force is F, so mv=Ft, giving v=Ft/m. For the instant just inside the field, avoid explicitly computing the current force first; compute Joule power caused by motional emf: P_J=epsilon^2/R=(BLv)^2/R. This power must come from mechanical work against an effective magnetic resistance force, so F_mag v=P_J, hence F_mag=B^2L^2v/R. Then a=(F-F_mag)/m using the entry speed. For maximum speed, use steady-state power balance: external power Fv equals Joule heating (BLv)^2/R, so v_max=FR/(B^2L^2).

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中有上下两条平行金属导轨，左端接有一个标为 R 的电阻；一根竖直金属棒跨接在两导轨之间，棒上有向右的恒力 F 箭头。棒右侧有一条竖直虚线边界，虚线右侧区域画有多个叉号，表示磁场垂直纸面向里；右侧用竖直双箭头标出两导轨间距 l，对应题中 L。推理：取题给常量 L=0.1 m，R=0.01 Ω，m=0.1 kg，F=0.1 N，t=2 s，B=0.2 T。进入磁场前没有磁阻力，水平面光滑，水平方向只有恒力 F，金属棒从静止开始，按冲量关系 mv=Ft，得 v=Ft/m=(0.1×2)/0.1=2 m/s。刚进入磁场时，动生电动势 epsilon=BLv，焦耳热功率 P_J=epsilon^2/R=(BLv)^2/R。该功率来自克服磁阻力做功，所以 F_mag v=P_J，得 F_mag=B^2L^2v/R。代入 v=2 m/s：F_mag=(0.2^2×0.1^2×2)/0.01=0.08 N，方向阻碍运动。此时合力 F-F_mag=0.1-0.08=0.02 N，所以加速度 a=(F-F_mag)/m=0.02/0.1=0.2 m/s^2。最大速度对应稳态，外力功率等于焦耳热功率：Fv=(BLv)^2/R，因此 v_max=FR/(B^2L^2)=(0.1×0.01)/(0.2^2×0.1^2)=2.5 m/s。

method.method_draft: Read the picture first: the rod is initially left of the dashed line, so it is outside the magnetic field; the field region with crosses is on the right; the rod remains perpendicular to the rails and spans the rail spacing L/l; the resistor closes the circuit on the left. From the text use F, m, t, B, L, and R. Model the motion in two stages with differential equations. Stage 1, before the field: m dv/dt=F with v(0)=0, so v(t)=Ft/m and at t=2 s the entry speed is found. Stage 2, once in the field: the moving rod has motional emf BLv and the resulting magnetic damping is proportional to speed, so write m dv/dt=F-kv where k=B^2L^2/R. Evaluate dv/dt=(F-kv)/m at the initial condition v=entry speed to get the just-entering acceleration. Then solve or analyze the ODE: v(t)=v_terminal+(v_entry-v_terminal)e^{-kt/m}, so the limiting and maximum speed is v_terminal=F/k=FR/(B^2L^2), since the entry speed is below this limit.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：两张附图显示的是同一装置：两条水平平行金属导轨，左端通过电阻 R 闭合；一根竖直金属杆跨接在两导轨之间并与导轨垂直；杆旁有向右的外力 F 箭头；右侧虚线之后的区域画有多个叉号，表示磁场垂直纸面向里；导轨间距在右侧标为 l，即题中 L。金属杆开始时位于虚线左侧，因此进入磁场前不受磁场作用。
推理：第一阶段，金属杆进入磁场前只受恒力 F，且从静止开始，所以 m dv/dt = F。进入磁场前经过 t=2 s，速度 v = Ft/m = 0.1 × 2 / 0.1 = 2 m/s。
第二阶段，金属杆刚进入磁场后，运动切割磁感线产生感应电动势 ε = BLv，电流 I = ε/R = BLv/R。安培阻力大小 F_B = BIL = B^2 L^2 v / R = kv，其中 k = B^2 L^2/R。代入 B=0.2 T，L=0.1 m，R=0.01 Ω，得 k = (0.2)^2(0.1)^2/0.01 = 0.04 N·s/m。刚进入磁场时 v=2 m/s，磁阻力为 kv=0.04×2=0.08 N，合力为 F-kv=0.1-0.08=0.02 N，所以加速度 a=(F-kv)/m=0.02/0.1=0.2 m/s^2。
进入磁场后的运动方程为 m dv/dt = F-kv，其极限速度满足 F=kv_max，因此 v_max=F/k=0.1/0.04=2.5 m/s。由于进入磁场时速度 2 m/s 小于 2.5 m/s，所以最大速度就是该终端速度。

1. v = 2 m/s
2. a = 0.2 m/s²
3. vmax = 2.5 m/s

raw_record.original_question:
As shown in the figure, two parallel metal rails with a spacing of $L=0.1\mathrm{m}$ on a horizontal plane (the plane of the paper) are connected at the left end to a resistor with a resistance of $R=0.01\Omega$. A smooth metal rod with a mass of $m=0.1\mathrm{kg}$ is placed on the rails. The metal rod starts from rest under the action of a constant horizontal force $F=0.1\mathrm{N}$ directed to the right. After a time $t=2\mathrm{s}$, the metal rod enters a magnetic field with a velocity $v$. The magnetic field has a magnetic induction strength of $B=0.2\mathrm{T}$ and is directed perpendicularly into the plane of the paper (the magnetic field region is sufficiently large, and the rails are sufficiently long). The resistance of the rod and the rails is negligible, and they remain perpendicular and in good contact at all times. Find:

1. What is the magnitude of the velocity $v$ of the metal rod as it enters the magnetic field?
2. What is the magnitude of the acceleration $a$ of the metal rod as it just enters the magnetic field?
3. What is the maximum speed that a metal rod can reach?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there are two horizontal parallel metal rails, whose left end is connected into a circuit by a resistor labeled R; a vertical metal rod is connected across the two rails, and the rod is subjected to a constant force F to the right; on the right side there is a vertical dashed line, indicating the starting boundary of the magnetic-field region; to the right of the dashed line there are multiple crosses drawn, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface inward; the distance between the rails is labeled l on the right side, namely the L given in the problem.

Reasoning calculation: The problem gives L=0.1 m, R=0.01 Ω, m=0.1 kg, F=0.1 N, t=2 s, B=0.2 T. Before the metal rod enters the magnetic field, it is not subjected to magnetic force, and only the constant force F acts, so the initial-stage acceleration is a0=F/m=0.1/0.1=1 m/s². The rod starts from rest and enters the magnetic field after moving for 2 s, therefore the velocity when entering the magnetic field is v=a0 t=1×2=2 m/s.

Just when entering the magnetic field, the metal rod cuts magnetic induction lines and produces motional electromotive force ε=BLv=0.2×0.1×2=0.04 V. The circuit current is I=ε/R=0.04/0.01=4 A. By Lenz's law, the magnetic force hinders the rod from moving to the right, and its magnitude is FB=BIL=0.2×4×0.1=0.08 N. At this time the resultant force is F-FB=0.1-0.08=0.02 N, so the magnitude of acceleration is a=(F-FB)/m=0.02/0.1=0.2 m/s².

When the metal rod reaches the maximum velocity, the acceleration is zero, and the magnetic resistance force balances the external force: F=B²L²vmax/R. Therefore vmax=FR/(B²L²)=0.1×0.01/(0.2²×0.1²)=0.001/0.0004=2.5 m/s.
